Since 1940 is earlier than 1985, "Ghar Ki Rani" should have been identified as the first film. However, the Planner incorrectly concluded that "Heaven Help Us (1985) was released first" and introduced an invalid criterion ("U.S. market release chronology") to justify this, ignoring the actual release years of the films themselves. This contradicts the known answer and the evidence provided by the WebSurfer.
